title: Connection Resilience
description: Handle transient Azure SQL failures with retry policies, circuit breakers, and execution strategies.

data.text: Cloud databases occasionally fail transiently due to maintenance, failovers, or throttling. EF Core and ADO.NET provide built-in retry mechanisms that make your ASP.NET Core app resilient without manual error handling everywhere.

items: Throttling from exceeded DTU or vCore limits
Network blips between App Service and Azure SQL

data.title: Exponential retry with Azure SQL
data.content: Use `EnableRetryOnFailure` for automatic retries on transient failures.

data.text: For complex operations, you can wrap multiple database calls in an explicit execution strategy.

data.title: Execute a transaction with retries
data.content: Use `CreateExecutionStrategy` to retry an entire transaction.

data.title: Idempotency matters
data.text: Retried operations must be idempotent. Avoid side effects outside the transaction, such as sending emails or enqueueing background jobs, inside the retried block.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure SQL transient failures are normal and expected
data.takeaway: Resilience is a requirement in cloud databases, not an afterthought. EF Core makes it easy to add retries with minimal code.
